verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs state you can start agent tasks and "watch them execute live", so the live-viewing half of the story is documented, though only in a single overview line. Nothing in the evidence shows a human taking over a running agent session. The CDP WebSocket endpoint is programmatic access and recordings are after-the-fact replay, so neither counts as live human takeover. Missing for 10: documented human takeover or interactive control of a live session mid-run, details of the live-view mechanism (e.g. embeddable live URL), and any hands-on corroboration.
